adds.title: ILGA-Europe rankings - 2016, 2019, 2024
adds.summary: In the 2026 ranking Russia scored 2%, among the lowest in Europe, and maintains explicit bans or other legal limitations that make legal gender recognition practically impossible with no self-determination procedure.

adds.title: Marriages (Tristan da Cunha) Ordinance, 2017
adds.summary: Tristan da Cunha legalized same-sex marriage through the Marriages (Tristan da Cunha) Ordinance 2017 effective 4 August 2017, defining marriage as the union of two persons regardless of sex and extending eligibility, formalities, rights and recognition to same-sex couples on equal terms with opposite-sex couples.
